text: Project Agent Instructions（DSH 网页插件）：把项目目录中的 Agent 指令文件加入 agent 的系统提示词。agent 创建时，插件从当前工作目录及其祖先目录查找默认的 .dsh/AGENTS.md，也支持在设置页增加读取路径；该默认路径始终保留。文件内容按可配置字节上限截断并以专门段落注入，插件还提供路径和上限的设置界面。适合希望让 DSH agent 自动遵循项目说明的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

Project Agent Instructions is a DSH web plugin that finds .dsh/AGENTS.md in an agent’s working directory or ancestors and adds it to the system prompt. Additional paths and a byte limit are configurable in its settings page. No API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH agent 自动读取项目里的 AGENTS.md 并放进系统提示词。
不同项目有各自的指令文件，怎么让 agent 按当前项目加载？
How can I add project-specific instruction files to each DSH agent prompt automatically?
Project Agent Instructions 的功能「项目指令注入」：agent 创建时从当前工作目录及祖先目录查找指令文件，将找到的内容作为专门段落加入系统提示词；默认路径是 .dsh/AGENTS.md。
Project Agent Instructions 的功能「路径与大小设置」：网页插件设置页可调整额外读取路径和最大字节数；默认路径始终保留，超限内容按 UTF-8 边界截断。

@shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions README · @shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions：A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) Cordis plugin that loads project-level agent instruction files and injects them into every agent's system prompt.

By default it reads **`.dsh/AGENTS.md`** from the session working directory, walking up through ancestor directories until a match is found. Additional relative paths can be configured on the plugin's settings page.

@shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions README · Features：- Injects the nearest `.dsh/AGENTS.md` (project root and ancestors supported) into the system prompt as a dedicated section.
- Custom additional read paths, relative to the project root.
- `.dsh/AGENTS.md` is always included and cannot be removed from the read list.
- Configurable size limit with UTF-8-safe truncation (default 32768 bytes).
- File watching: edits to the instruction file are picked up automatically without restarting.
- Settings page in the DSH Web UI (Plugins → this plugin), changes apply live.

@shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions README · Usage：Create `.dsh/AGENTS.md` in your project root:

```
my-project/
└── .dsh/
    └── AGENTS.md
```

Its content is automatically added to the system prompt of every agent started with that project as its working directory (or any subdirectory).

@shihaoshen/dsh-project-agent-instructions README · Settings：| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Additional read paths | Comma-separated paths relative to the project root; checked after `.dsh/AGENTS.md` | — |
| Maximum bytes | Files longer than this are truncated when injected | `32768` |
